title: The last one to eat (scene story)

captions.instagram:
You don't have to eat last to be a good bahu. 🪔

So many of us grew up watching the women at home eat after everyone else.
Rest, a hot meal, a seat at the table: they aren't rewards. They're yours too.
This Diwali, pull up a chair for the woman still in the kitchen.

Send this to the woman who always eats last.

#diwali #indianwomen #selfworth #emotionalwellness #soundmind
